title: The reference and the plane both changed
why: `causes` is ordered as the gate table lists them, and the only other multi-cause case pairs `reference-changed` with `element-ambiguous` — so nothing pinned where `plane-changed` sits relative to `reference-changed`, and an engine emitting them the other way round passed. This pair is also the one a real reference refresh produces, since re-rendering a reference usually moves its content box too.
